text.tspan: Transformer-XL relative attention | Operators & tensor flow
Relative AC+shift(BD) / memory4,current3 / heads2x8 / post-norm / eval / read bottom to top
Current T3; memoryM4; K7; two heads width8; external relative encodings and separate biases.
Content score AC and shifted relative score BD are separate source branches.
Caller memory is consumed; output contains current positions only; no memory update is drawn.
Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.
E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.
Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.
